package.name: stereo_calib
package.description:
RViz visualization + ROS1 nodes for the qualisys + 3 RealSense calibration tree. The Python library itself is poetry-managed; this package.xml exists so roslaunch can find launch files and node scripts via `pkg="stereo_calib"`.
Usage: add the repo directory to ROS_PACKAGE_PATH, e.g. export ROS_PACKAGE_PATH=$HOME/Desktop/stereo-calib:$ROS_PACKAGE_PATH
